title: QuickBooks settings are hidden when the Integrations sub-toggle is OFF
preconds: 1. A custom role has Settings ON but the Integrations sub-toggle OFF, with a user assigned.
steps:
1. Log in as that user.
  2. Open the Settings area and look for the Integrations pages.
  3. Look for QuickBooks.
  4. Try to open the QuickBooks settings address directly.
expected:
The Integrations pages (including QuickBooks) are not shown.

Opening the QuickBooks address directly is refused.

Build finding: the live build keeps QuickBooks under the Integrations settings (gated by the Integrations sub-toggle) — the 'move QuickBooks to Finance / remove Integrations' premise is not in the build and is stale versus the current spec.
